rules.new_C0_rule: Caption declarations bind deictic site roles in the common panel environment before instruction interpretation; this is a distinct caption channel, not chronology or a unique object leader.

Every complete record has a local evaluator. Explicit lexical entry/call/reference operations import named config or trial data. Shared panel alone carries no runtime state. An UNKNOWN within a record freezes pending state through every later known token. Q1 OTCHDY explicitly imports the complete static F0 declarations from P4_01 plus caption roles and fixed protocol parameters, not P4/P5 later runtime state; SHEDAL supplies its own prepared portion. Prior immutable declarations remain referenceable without resuming the failed record.

Preparation operator starts a new preparation pass using explicit current/next configuration operands; cursor resets to A. OTAL, OLDY, SAIRN and RAR close different explicitly named setup/check/preparation/assay stages; no universal DY closure.

Typed nouns/parameters select or introduce their stated registers. A repeated medium-kind name retains kind; SAIIN creates a fresh portion. QOKY explicitly allocates one portion from the selected kind if the carrier is empty and no current portion is selected; otherwise it loads the selected portion. This constructor is priced, never a silent kind-to-instance coercion. Actions consume their listed registers; a missing register is UNBOUND.

Twenty chosen P4/P5 attachment spans listed in main_constructions compose their individual meanings in written order. Following arguments and goal predicates are collected before their governing operation executes. In P5_03 SY is a constraint on the fresh portion introduced by following SAIIN, rather than an assertion about a discharged previous portion. These are twenty paid postexposure templates, not independently found sentence boundaries or parser uniqueness.

Finite Cdy family: CHDY stores R; OTCHDY designates R; QOKCHDY invokes R with written following input and origin. Same conceptual kernel plus whole-specific residual arity/entry rules; no universal ot/qok stripping or outside-family production.

Invocation schema [OTCHDY QOKCHDY SHEDAL DAL CHEOL] generates e1 from R,p,A,D and records u1. D is a captured caption-defined contextual argument. R has four priced internal steps: close the nonselected origin, release selected-origin/return gates, place p, wait Delta. R does not guarantee an arrival or perform CHEOL automatically; the written CHEOL supplies the observation assertion.

Replay schema [LOL CHDAL AIIN] copies the exact complete preceding invocation-and-read prototype; changes only source to B, preserves p,D,Delta, creates new event e2 and readout u2. Copies an operation plan, not a physical component identity.

[SOL DAIIIN CHEDY] preserves trace; DAIIIN requires two positive readouts from distinct trials; CHEDY supplies route criterion. No aiin=III or daiiin=daiin alias. Records a stated conditional test conclusion, not real evidence of transit.

SOLKEEY explicitly imports latest completed named-assay TrialPair in same panel/page. QEKEY selects its first event; SOLCHKAL selects its second. CHEOL retains one event-result signature everywhere, including f77. Reconsuming the same event selects the same readout identity; it does not create a fresh trial or independent observation.
[DAIIN OL DAIN CHEY LDALOR] distributes the same typed preservation/route claim over both retained trials; no invented third invocation.
[SOL RTAIN CTHOL] concludes both origins link to D; exact ZL CTHAL instead concludes the last origin B links to D. RF split R/TAIN and marked CTH@221;L receive no join or value.

The exact raw literals IT ?cheol, ZL [?:s]cheol and RF ocheol are separately hypothesized negative calibration readouts. This finite same-denotation family is charged; no prefix deletion, resolved glyph identity or morphological negation law follows.

ZL S followed by OKEEDY composes enabled load-ready goal without deleting the uncertain seam. S AIIN is not equated with whole SAIIN; AIIN lacks GoalPredicate type there, so that separated alternative remains a type/scope debt, not a silently repaired aliquot.

Each caption is a complete whole with explicit value. OLSAIIN describes counterpart use of Q1 prototype cataphorically; it does not execute a third trial. SAROLDAL excludes S50; SASOLDAL permits optional S50; neither forces caption/record pairing.

ProcedureSpec is a parametric identity: isolated OTCHDY denotes R with formal parameters, not a partially executed event. Naming does not instantiate or coerce a component into an operation. Explicit Q1 designation/call binds its arguments from the named static F0 and captions.

assumptions_and_prices.new_C0_dependency: C83 is embedded as an assay configuration; F_L/F_R are station neighborhoods, not identified women/subjects.
CHTOROL deictically assigns A to S45 without a unique pictured object owner.
OLSAIIN deictically assigns B to S46 and a forward Q1 prototype without nearest-caption bijection.
DAROLSY deictically assigns D to S51 without a unique pictured outlet owner.
SAROLDAL or SASOLDAL constrains local S50; raw RF caption remains unknown.
The continuous arch H is a usable route in the authored assay, not ink-established fluid flow.
A fixed aromatic test medium M and carrier V are introduced by named P4 words; actual material and hardware are not identified.
Positive symbolic waiting interval Delta is fixed for every protocol stage; no word gives a number or unit.
Reference-control path Kref and placement/drive setting K are procedure parameters; they are not drawn/translated independently.
Closed Kref predicts no signal and opened Kref predicts signal; this is an initial reference-standard assumption, not manuscript evidence.
R has four internal gate/place/wait substeps; CHEOL is the separate written observation consumer, and invocation alone does not guarantee positive arrival.
SHEDAL introduces a prepared portion of M; no same physical aliquot is carried from P4 or f77 automatically.
LOL carries the same p between its two explicitly described tests, rather than creating a second specimen.
Local complete records are externally fixed by source map; RF windows are not native paragraph confirmations.
TECHEDY imports completed P4 ReadyFrame; alternate incomplete P4 cannot donate it for free.
SOLKEEY imports Q1 TrialPair to Q2 by explicit lexical reference; both results must exist before selection.
Named procedure identity may occur medially as a reference; no heading-only claim or corpus-wide one-f77-object claim.
Other global exact occurrences remain a meaning-accounting debt; full f77 predecessor is unparsed because its opening OTEDY is unassigned.
Twenty P4/P5 and seven Q1/Q2 span attachments are chosen exploratory constructions; no physical line implies a sentence.
Types and consumer signatures are author-specific C0 hypotheses, not independently shared semantic grammar.
QOKY portion allocation when only a kind is selected is an explicit new constructor, not inherited grammar.

Q1 designation imports only complete static F0 declarations and known captions; R supplies its own gate preparation and SHEDAL supplies its own prepared portion. An incomplete P5 is not reset or asserted complete.
Repeated CHEOL for the same selected event refers to the same readout identity, not a fresh measurement.
An uninstantiated parametric procedure may be named by an isolated OTCHDY label; only an explicit invocation binds its formal arguments.

Arrival is perception of a sensory marker associated with p at D, not displacement of the entire physical portion. CHEY concerns the source input identity/kind; same p may be repositioned by the next invoke/place step. MarkerOf(p) is a new derived signal-type hypothesis, not a separately identified word or measured substance.

Counterpart-control constructions retain base_origin from their entry state; QOKAIN changes the invoked/output origin to its counterpart, while following KAIN references that retained base, not the newly invoked origin. This is a paid reference-anchor choice of P5_09, not a free context repair.
